description: This file defines the ActivityTransitionDetails class, an Android Activity that displays an image and handles scene transition animations, including loading resources, setting up the view, and handling click events to start a new activity with a transition.

classes.name: ActivityTransitionDetails
classes.description: An Android activity that displays an image and manages scene transition animations, with methods for image resource handling and user interaction.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets background color, inflates layout, and sets the displayed image.

methods.name: getHeroDrawable
methods.description: Retrieves the drawable resource based on intent extras, updates the image and name accordingly.

methods.name: clicked
methods.description: Handles click events to start the ActivityTransition with a shared element transition.

methods.name: randomColor
methods.description: Generates a random color with limited intensity for background.
